description: Leave Budget _category blank on rows containing a Year value while retaining category fill-down elsewhere.
before:
=LET(
  values, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "category"),
  positions, SEQUENCE(ROWS(values)),
  ARRAYFORMULA(
    IFNA(
      LOOKUP(
        positions,
        positions / (values <> ""),
        values
      ),
      ""
    )
  )
)
after:
=LET(
  values, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "category"),
  years, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "year"),
  positions, SEQUENCE(ROWS(values)),
  ARRAYFORMULA(
    IF(years<>"", "",
      IFNA(
        LOOKUP(
          positions,
          positions / (values <> ""),
          values
        ),
        ""
      )
    )
  )
)
repositoryScope: Only this migration record belongs to the change. No Apps Script source changed; clasp push is not required.
